prompt:
Write a client review left on a freelance platform for Mina Castellan after this project.

Project facts (the only truth you may use):
title: Marketing attribution analysis
client: Verdant Skincare
client_industry: e-commerce
start: 2021-05
end: 2021-07
engagement: hourly
stack:
- Google Analytics
- BigQuery
- Looker Studio
- SQL
implied_skills:
- multi-touch attribution
built: Joined ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare first-click,
  last-click and position-based credit.
metrics:
- 18% of ad budget reallocated
- customer acquisition cost down 12% the next quarter

The review is from: Verdant Skincare
Rating: 4.8 out of 5

Requirements:
- 2 to 5 sentences in the voice of a busy client, not a marketer.
- If the rating is below 4.5, include one honest complaint (communication, delays or scope).
- Only mention results that appear in the facts. Never use: "multi-touch attribution".
text: Mina helped us make sense of our marketing attribution across Google Analytics, BigQuery, and Looker Studio without making it a headache for our team. She joined our ad platform spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery and gave us a clear comparison of first-click, last-click, and position-based credit. As a result, we reallocated 18% of our ad budget, and our customer acquisition cost was down 12% the next quarter. Solid work and easy to work with.
